journalist.title: Marcus Vale trade demand reported
journalist.body: A trade-demand story broke this week and hangs over everything; the front office has not responded publicly.

scout.body: Elite two-way production; the numbers have not blinked through the noise.

influencer.body: The room has soured — the standoff dominates every thread and the patience is thinning.

analyst.body: Feeling is dragging the arc down while the production holds its line.

tone: Reflective, economical and quietly evocative. Use a light metaphor only when it clarifies the reading.
